title: pvPointDatatoCellData
body:
## pvPointDatatoCellData

Converts point arrays to cell arrays by averaging, for each cell, the values at its points; with CategoricalData the most frequent value among the cell's points wins instead, which suits integer labels. The output is the same dataset type with new cell arrays, and by ParaView default the point arrays are dropped. Use it when a step needs cell data, e.g. per-cell statistics or cell-based thresholds; pointToCell is the curated version, and cellToPoint or pvCellDatatoPointData go the other way.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Averaging smooths sharp gradients and is not a conservative transfer of extensive quantities.
- With CategoricalData, a cell whose points carry two equally frequent labels gets one of them deterministically, but VTK's code and its own comment disagree on which (the code's std::max_element keeps the larger value); do not rely on tie order and avoid ties by labelling consistently.
- PassPointData defaults to false here (unlike pointToCell); enable it if later nodes still need the point arrays.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `PointDatatoCellData`. Identity: `filters/PointDataToCellData`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Point Data to Cell Data filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). The input needs at least one point-centred array. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CategoricalData` | Control whether the input point data is to be treated as categorical. If the data is categorical, then the resultant cell data will be determined by a majority rules vote, with ties going to the smaller value. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `PassPointData` | The value of this property controls whether the input point data will be passed to the output. If set to 1, then the input point data is passed through to the output; otherwise, only generated cell data is placed into the output. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `PointDataArraytoprocess` | Add a point array by name to be converted to cell array. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ProcessAllArrays` | The value of this property controls whether all input point arrays will be processed and converted into cell arrays. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
